2022Preprint / conference paper

Reasoning methods

Worked reasoning examples guide prompting

Prompts containing intermediate reasoning examples improved performance on several reasoning benchmarks.

Jason Wei and colleagues

The contribution

The paper studied demonstrations that include a sequence of intermediate steps before an answer. With sufficiently large language models, these worked examples improved results on tasks such as arithmetic and symbolic reasoning.

What this does not establish

A generated chain of thought is not guaranteed to be correct or a faithful account of the model computation. This paper is distinct from zero-shot step-by-step prompting.

Why this date?

The preprint was first submitted in January 2022.

This entry follows the linked publication. Read the source and date conventions.
